bagPolicy.summary: Bags are allowed and searched at entry. The theatre has no coat check and recommends leaving luggage and multiple shopping bags at home.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue FAQ does not publish a dedicated parking lot, rate or event parking plan.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drinks are prohibited except when medically necessary. Contact the theatre at least 48 hours before the performance about special dietary needs.
